answer: One enforceable rule: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the quill to sunk effort, uses the vine as an corroborating signal, then requires a ripple before any payout.
